name: Saint I-spec right-hand shifter
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 114 g for the SL-M820-B-I I-spec right-hand ten-speed control, explicitly identified as Right. This is a genuine single control for the Saint 1x10 drivetrain; no fictitious left counterpart or pair total is added.
